basic_info.description: Endless Possibilities in the Heart of Bayview! Discover the incredible potential of this expanded 3-bedroom, 1-bath home, now upgraded with a newly added primary suite and ensuite bath, plus three additional rooms and four bathrooms! Built in 1924, this spacious 1,325 sq. ft. gem is ready for your personal touch. A generous 2-car garage and ample storage make city living effortless. Located in the vibrant Bayview District, you’ll enjoy easy access to public transportation, trendy shops, the Chase Center, and the scenic Adam Rogers and Hilltop Parks—perfect for an active urban lifestyle. But that's not all! This property features a bonus lower-level unit with its own private entrance and separate address (1677 Keith St). The unit includes two additional bedrooms, a full bath, a spacious living area, and a modernized kitchen—ideal for multi-generational living or income potential. Stylishly updated with sleek lighting and contemporary finishes, this space is move-in ready. Please note: The permit status for these additions is unknown. Don’t miss this rare opportunity to customize, invest, and create your dream home!
